safety.text: Medical emergency or someone hurt: call 911 now.
Stay at least 30 feet from downed lines, including the line to your house. Report them to AEP.
Run generators outdoors only, far from windows. Carbon monoxide can kill.

checklist: Charge phones, power banks and laptops tonight.
Have flashlights and spare batteries ready (no candles).
Store 1 gallon of water per person per day for 3 days.
Stock food that needs no cooking or refrigeration.
Keep the fridge and freezer closed; food stays cold about 4 hours (fridge) and 48 hours (full freezer).
Get some cash; card readers may be down.
Arrange a check-in with a neighbour.
